question: Whether standards/index.json's year, number and ncc_hook fields should be corrected to agree with NCC 2025 Schedule 2, and by what rule where a standard has more than one referenced edition
needs: A decision on the rule, then the edits. Three classes, 12 entries, all now carrying an edition_note in standards/index.json. (a) year disagrees with the referenced edition: AS 1668.2 (index 2012, Schedule 2 2024), AS 1670.1 (2018 / 2024), AS 1530.1 (1994 / 2024), AS/NZS 3500.2 (2021 / 2025), and AS/NZS 3500.1 (2021, where Schedule 2 lists both 2018 and 2025 so no single year is correct). (b) number does not match the form Schedule 2 prints: AS 1428.4.1 is printed AS/NZS 1428 Part 4.1, AS 1530.3 is printed AS/NZS 1530 Part 3 - both joint standards recorded in the index without the NZS. (c) ncc_hook is not supported by Schedule 2: AS/NZS 3000 (hook cites Section J and Part E; not in the national table at all, only NSW), AS/NZS 3008.1.1 (hook routes via AS/NZS 3000, itself not nationally referenced), AS/NZS 1680.1 (Part 0 is referenced, Part 1 is not), AS 2890.1 (Part 6 is referenced, Part 1 is not). AS 1428.1 also needs the rule: its year of 2021 is right but hides a 2001 edition and a 1993 Supplement that Schedule 2 also lists against different clauses.
why_deferred: Deferred from the Schedule 2 recording pass, which was scoped to record what Schedule 2 says and explicitly not to change any existing field. Correcting year is not a transcription task - it is a decision about what the field means. If year means the standard's own current edition, four of the five are not wrong and only the reader was; if it means the edition the NCC calls up, it must become jurisdiction-aware and edition-plural, because AS 1428.1 and AS/NZS 3500.1 each have more than one live at once and AS/NZS 3000 has none nationally. Overwriting year in place would also erase the pre-2025 position, which a job approved under an earlier NCC edition still needs. Today the discrepancies are visible and dated in each entry's edition_note with the Schedule 2 evidence beside them, so nothing is silently wrong while the decision waits - which is why this is a follow-on and not a blocker. Needs the pack owner's decision on the meaning of year before any field is touched.
